content_sections.heading: NABCONS Job Description
content_sections.text: The consultants shall perform project management activities pertaining to the implementation of the Mission for Atmanirbharta in Pulses across several domains: Policy & Strategy Support: Review current pan-India situation, identify gaps, support strategy document preparation, assist in convergence across schemes, identify best practices, and suggest mid-course corrections. Stakeholder Management & Coordination: Coordinate and report to high-level stakeholders including PMO, NITI Aayog, and line Ministries; assist States/UTs in scheme guidelines; support handholding and capacity building. Program Implementation & Monitoring: Facilitate periodic monitoring against performance indicators, track ground-level issues, and assist in preparing review reports. Knowledge Management & Capacity Building: Document lessons learned, success stories, and innovative practices; disseminate guidelines and FAQs; facilitate cross-learning between States/UTs. Other Tasks: Assist DA&FW with media documentation, transportation logistics using GPS-enabled systems, accommodation booking, e-tendering support, digital branding, social media engagement, live streaming, designing digital platforms and dashboards, promoting AI/ML tools, ensuring cybersecurity, submitting monthly progress reports, and any other assigned task.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: BE/B.Tech Degree in CS/IT/Electronics or Equivalent; MBA/PGDM. Experience required: 3 - 6 Years in the portal development etc. Qualification required: MBA/PGDM in Agri-Business Management. Experience required: 3 - 6 years in Agriculture Sector or related field.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Candidate will be paid consolidated professional fees based on experience, educational qualification and overall suitability. Hired on contract basis initially for a period of 6 months, extendable based on project requirement and performance or co-terminus with the project period. NABCONS may terminate the engagement by giving three months notice in advance.
